title: Use the portal in the portal mobile app
description: A tenant can be opened in the portal mobile app once `public.mobileApp.enabled` / `PORTAL_TENANT_<ID>_PUBLIC_MOBILE_APP_ENABLED` is set to true; otherwise the app refuses to add it. In the app, signing in through an external provider runs in the phone's browser and comes back to the app signed in, and a portal already signed in there signs the app in directly. On Android, the app receives the portal's notifications as native push notifications, next to the existing browser notifications. Inside the app, the notifications toggle in the account settings turns them on and off for the device, and tapping a notification opens its page in the app. Sending them needs a Firebase service-account key file, named once for the whole deployment by `push.fcm.serviceAccountFile` / `PORTAL_PUSH_FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE`; without it the app receives no notifications and browsers are unaffected. Links to other sites in news, forum and other written content now open in a new window, and in the app in the device's browser.
